Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

For a leading logistics organization with branches in multiple countries, we are looking for a Truck Auditor for Zeebrugge.



Responsibilities:

You work in a two-shift rotation (morning and afternoon), and occasional day shifts.

Setting an example with the necessary assertiveness.

Willingness to learn on the job and follow instructions.

Problem-solving mindset.

No specific certificates required.

No specific education required.

Knowledge of an Eastern European language is a plus.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer (French-Dutch-English, Night Shifts), you are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. You’ll work within a small, supportive team to ensure that stranded vehicles or trucks get back on the road quickly. You’ll communicate by phone and email with customers, partners, and technical service providers. Your dedication and attention to detail help resolve a wide range of customer questions and issues, contributing to seamless service delivery.

On a typical day, you’ll handle incoming calls and emails, gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, and provide technical support where possible. You’ll keep customers and stakeholders updated, monitor agreements, and ensure all contract-related matters are handled within agreed deadlines. You’ll work night shifts from Thursday to Saturday (8:00 am to 8:00 pm), which allows for variety in your schedule and challenges your multitasking skills.

Are you a strong communicator, resilient under pressure, and customer-focused? Do you want to join a multicultural team where learning and growth are central? Apply today and discover how you can make a real impact for people in need.

• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English; any additional language is a plus

• Degree in higher secondary education, associate degree, or (professional/academic) bachelor

• Strong communication skills over phone and email

• Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)

• Accurate, resilient under stress, and able to multitask

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• Customer- and results-oriented

• No specific experience necessary; motivation and eagerness to learn are essential

We are looking for a highly motivated Logistics Operator  for a leading company in the industrial sector. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth internal transport and efficient warehouse management.

You will play a crucial role in the efficient and safe processing of goods within the industrial site.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!
